summary: Flat recognizer (dense hand-typed template matching + leftmost-ink slot windows at 12-px pitch + step one-hot slot selection) reaches exact match 1.000 / CER 0.000 on dev_main n=400, all lengths 1-8 perfect.
On 24 traced cases, min top1-top2 slot-logit margin is 9.9 and min EOS margin is 20.8 (winning digit scores 17.5-30.6), so decisions are not near threshold.
Glyph geometry for digits-mono/1: DejaVuSansMono 20px, glyph top row = 8 + y_jitter, height 15 rows, ink in advance-cell columns 1..10, first-ink bearing 1 (digit 1: 2), pitch exactly 12 px from x.
Exact-bitmap templates likely fail if the renderer adds blur, other fonts/sizes or sub-pixel positions; untested.
